author: Patrick Xjr
text:
Stay quiet wait until 90 days.
Don’t stress if value is different: we are all different so as HbA1c is an average on 3 month, CGM calculates with the average of sensor values on 90 days. It is theory. In reality Somme of us will have the last month weighing more…so if you are at +/- 0,20 it is not a drama. 
The most important is that your new way of life will be pleasant enough
Good luck
